description: The safe markdown pipeline behind TmMarkdownView: Markdig with raw HTML disabled, an explicit URL allowlist (http/https/mailto plus relative targets, everything else collapses to '#'), images limited to absolute http(s), links hardened with target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow", code blocks with a copy affordance and a keyboard-reachable <pre>, tables wrapped in a keyboard-reachable named region and cite: links turned into citation chips. Registered by AddTempoBlazorAI() through TryAddSingleton, so a host may replace it with a subclass.
